gates.name: no-orphan-references
gates.cmd: cd gauntlet-loop && for f in references/*.md; do grep -q "$(basename $f)" SKILL.md || echo "ORPHAN $f"; done

gates.name: no-dangling-paths
gates.cmd: cd gauntlet-loop && grep -oE 'references/[a-z-]+\.md' SKILL.md | sort -u | while read q; do [ -f "$q" ] || echo "DANGLING $q"; done

gates.name: no-unknown-flags
gates.cmd: cd gauntlet-loop && grep -oE '\-\-[a-z-]{3,}' SKILL.md | sort -u | while read q; do grep -q -- "\"$q\"" scripts/gauntlet.py || echo "UNKNOWN $q"; done
